scenario: Customer wants to return a laptop purchased 20 days ago. The laptop has a cracked screen which the customer says happened during shipping.
rules_excerpt: Electronics: 30-day return window. Damaged items: if reported within 48h of delivery, full refund + free return shipping. After 48h: inspect for warranty claim. Gold members: extended to 72h for damage reports. Laptops over $1000: manager approval required for refunds.
expected_resolution: Delivery was ~20 days ago, damage report is outside 72h Gold window. Cannot do direct return for shipping damage. Initiate warranty claim process. Escalate to manager given laptop price > $1000.
